name: figma-mcp-go
description: Figma MCP server with full read/write access through a local plugin. No API token, no rate limits. 60 tools for styles, variables, components, prototypes, and content.

tools.name: apply_style_to_node
tools.description: Apply a local style to a node.

tools.name: batch_execute_pipeline
tools.description: Run write steps in order. A step can use earlier results through $variables. On error, the tool undoes created nodes and changed properties only.

tools.name: batch_rename_nodes
tools.description: Rename nodes: set a name, find/replace (regex allowed), or add a prefix/suffix.

tools.name: boolean_operation
tools.description: Combine 2+ shapes with UNION, SUBTRACT, INTERSECT, or EXCLUDE.

tools.name: clone_node
tools.description: Copy a node, optionally to a new position or parent.

tools.name: combine_as_variants
tools.description: Combine 2+ components into a variant set.

tools.name: create_component
tools.description: Turn a FRAME into a COMPONENT, in place.

tools.name: create_component_instance
tools.description: Create an instance of a local or library component.

tools.name: create_connector
tools.description: Create a connector line. This tool operates only in a FigJam file.

tools.name: create_node
tools.description: Create a FRAME, RECTANGLE, ELLIPSE, STAR, POLYGON, LINE, or SECTION.

tools.name: create_style
tools.description: Create a PAINT, TEXT, EFFECT, or GRID style.

tools.name: create_text
tools.description: Create a text node (loads the font).

tools.name: create_vector
tools.description: Create a vector from SVG markup, e.g. an icon.

tools.name: delete_nodes
tools.description: Delete nodes.

tools.name: delete_style
tools.description: Delete a style by ID.

tools.name: detach_instance
tools.description: Detach instances into plain frames.

tools.name: export_frames_to_pdf
tools.description: Export frames as one PDF, one page per frame.

tools.name: export_screenshots
tools.description: Export nodes as images, saved to file or returned inline.

tools.name: export_tokens
tools.description: Export variables and paint styles as JSON or CSS variables.

tools.name: find_replace_text
tools.description: Find and replace text in TEXT nodes.

tools.name: flatten_nodes
tools.description: Merge nodes into one vector.

tools.name: get_annotations
tools.description: Get Dev Mode annotations on the page or on one node.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get the node tree of the selection, page, or whole file.

tools.name: get_fonts
tools.description: List fonts used on the current page, most used first.

tools.name: get_image_bytes
tools.description: Get the original image files in nodes' image fills, as base64.

tools.name: get_instance_overrides
tools.description: Get an instance's component properties and values.

tools.name: get_local_components
tools.description: Get all components in the file.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Get file name, current page, and all pages.

tools.name: get_nodes_info
tools.description: Get full node details by ID.

tools.name: get_reactions
tools.description: Get a node's prototype reactions.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Get selected nodes, or nodes pinned in the plugin panel.

tools.name: get_styles
tools.description: Get local paint, text, effect, and grid styles.

tools.name: get_variable_defs
tools.description: Get local variables: collections, modes, and values.

tools.name: get_viewport
tools.description: Get viewport center, zoom, and visible bounds.

tools.name: group_nodes
tools.description: Group 2+ nodes that share a parent.

tools.name: import_image
tools.description: Add an image from a URL or base64, as a new rectangle or into a node's fill.

tools.name: manage_component_properties
tools.description: Add, edit, delete, or bind component properties.

tools.name: manage_page
tools.description: Add, delete, rename, or go to a page.

tools.name: manage_plugin_data
tools.description: Store key/value data on a node, saved in the file.

tools.name: manage_variable
tools.description: Create, set, delete, and bind variables (design tokens).

tools.name: outline_stroke
tools.description: Turn a node's stroke into a filled shape.

tools.name: reparent_nodes
tools.description: Move nodes into another frame, group, or section.

tools.name: save_version_checkpoint
tools.description: Save a named version in file history.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Find nodes by name, type, or both.

tools.name: set_annotations
tools.description: Set or clear Dev Mode annotations on nodes.

tools.name: set_auto_layout
tools.description: Set auto layout: direction, padding, gap, align, and HUG/FILL sizing.

tools.name: set_codegen_result
tools.description: Save code on a node for Dev Mode's Code panel.

tools.name: set_effects
tools.description: Set a node's shadows, blurs, and other effects.

tools.name: set_export_settings
tools.description: Set a node's Export presets.

tools.name: set_instance_overrides
tools.description: Set an instance's component properties.

tools.name: set_layout_grids
tools.description: Set column, row, or square layout grids on frames.

tools.name: set_node_properties
tools.description: Set position, size, radius, visibility, opacity, rotation, constraints, and more.

tools.name: set_paint
tools.description: Set a node's solid or gradient fill, or its stroke.

tools.name: set_reactions
tools.description: Set or remove prototype reactions.

tools.name: set_selection
tools.description: Select and zoom to nodes to show the user.

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Change a TEXT node's text and whole-node text settings.

tools.name: set_text_ranges
tools.description: Style parts of a text: bold, color, link, list.

tools.name: swap_component
tools.description: Swap an instance to another local or library component.

tools.name: ungroup_nodes
tools.description: Ungroup GROUP nodes.

tools.name: update_paint_style
tools.description: Update a paint style's name, color, or description.
